text.p: --Montgomery Securities analyst David Crossen initiated coverage of Matritech Inc with a buy rating.
--Crossen said he expects the company to earn $0.46 per share in fiscal 1998 and $1.50 in 1999. His one-year target price is $18, or about 63 percent above current levels.

--He added that there are investment risks associated with this company, but that they are justified by the data that he has seen thus far "on the immense potential of a cancer-screening diagnostic could have on the market."
--Matritech uses proprietary nuclear matrix technology and diagnostics to detect various forms of cancer.
